name: LaneArc
summary: SVG arc renderer over a faint base map. The arc draws in on mount via stroke-dasharray animation (cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), 1200ms). Lime-accent tinted by default. Origin + destination markers at endpoints. Honors prefers-reduced-motion (arc renders instantly).

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER use LaneArc as a static decoration — the animation is the point.
NEVER stack more than 3 arcs (visual noise).
